title: Plugin Registry Purpose
description: In-memory record of installed plugins with lazy manifest resolution.
body: Installed plugins: what is on this machine, and what each one can show. A **plugin** is a checkout carrying a `kaava-tool.toml`. One of them is a *package* holding zero or more *surfaces*, and a surface is the thing that reaches the switcher bar. Deliberately not `discovery.rs`, and the manifest behind a record is re-read rather than cached — which is what the reload loop is built on.
